items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I told Shy, I said, you can get drunk if you want... Shy used to take care of him when he gets drunk... And he called me a sissy.

ctx.x: Are you used to be used to this drink? That's right.

No. The first time I drank in my life, just to sound like a joke. We come from the planet that I was supposed to be the biggest dance hall. One of the biggest dance hall in the world. White and colored just danced that together. But when we went there, they put a rope in between. A rope? Just one rope. White on one side, colored one side. I mean, it was some confusion happened or a new man of town or something. I don't know. And I told Shy, I said, you can get drunk if you want. You're going to go to jail. I'm…
